selection: 96 same-index procedures; each must qualify all4folds at all5donors; fold and donor equalweight; no heldout Q1/Q2/H2 scores
representation: Reinstantiate selected procedure on each budget/seed own LOFO fitting set; own scalers and relative gamma, no mainfull2019 transforms
target_only: Own V1 raw-missing-preserving target-only cache; ns0,ntN,Weighted-SVQR backend; same externally selected SVQR recipe
source: Fixed audited V1 evenlyspaced1200 normal2019 rows per donor site (maximum6000); actual counts disclosed; no heldout normal labels
outputs: Native9 unmodified raw predictions; point integratedmean and originaltau0.5; nominal95 endpoints; prob95-selected WIS diagnostic
assessment: Raw heldout H2, retrospective; noheldout Q2calibration; score requiresmainrelease and allLOFOchoices/finalattempts frozen
failure: All attempts persisted; missing choice or any missingseed/site makes aggregate NR; no fallback after assessment
deadline_policy: Development was stopped at the recorded cutoff; selection used only candidates that completed every required fold and met the numerical criteria. Failed and unfinished attempts are recorded separately.
